note: Two columns of recommendation text without arrows (cervical dysplasia / cervical cancer screening in PWH; cervical cancer in PWH), the page INTRO-1 sends cervical cancer to. The old extraction cut the columns into loose fragments and left no entry box; each column is one list box that patients enter. The screening column holds general recommendations (no condition); the cervical cancer column applies when the primary cancer is cervical cancer.
